scope: Native ToolRuntime execution events and monotonic guard; agent/pre-step and agent/turn-stopping are published at the same revision in packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts.

events.name: tools/execute
events.reason: Other extensions can transform or short-circuit this middleware, so it is not treated as authoritative tool-body success evidence.

events.name: tools/post-execute
events.reason: Post middleware can transform outcomes; Reconc observes the final frozen result without claiming original tool-body success.

events.name: tools/ptc-dispatch-log
events.reason: This event transforms a durable log copy of nested dispatch content, not the execution decision.
